turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail:
contact Customer Care within 30 days of delivery with your order reference, product code, and a photo. They’ll review it; if it’s out of stock, you’ll receive store credit or a refund. The only stated fee is US$8 per return under the U.S. ReturnHelper process, plus any return shipping or taxes. General return shipping fees and customs duties/taxes aren’t refunded—so contact Customer Care rather than assuming the standard-return fee applies.
